note: 2026-11-03 (package ECON3, ECON2-10): fights that sit in a published map layout (card_overrides __cfg:map-layout:<mapId>, which wins over a node's fixedPos) and are closer than 7% of the canvas to their neighbour, or sit under the full title panel a map shows on its first look. The game code cannot move them; 20261103_econ3_map_layout.sql does, once the owner says 'apply it'. 'key' is the fight's id today, 'rowKey' the key the row stores it under (rows saved before the 2026-10-14 rename keep the old key). tests/e2e/econ3_2026_11_03.py applies these on top of the live rows (tests/fixtures/econ3-live-map-layout-2026-11-03.json).
